name: AMD ROCm: Open-source software stack for AMD GPU computing
notes: ROCm is an open-source software stack for AMD GPU computing. Powered by HIP (C++ runtime API similar to CUDA). Supports OpenMP, OpenCL. Includes compilers, debuggers, libraries. Integrates with PyTorch, TensorFlow. Supports CDNA4, CDNA3, CDNA2, RDNA4, RDNA3. 6.8k stars. Being deprecated in favor of ROCm/TheRock.
